nodes.title: Selig S5010 coordinates as used by the wing CAD
nodes.where: redesign/subsystems/wing/s5010.dat read with redesign/fusion/k09kit.surface_z at chord 0.32 m
nodes.note: the same file and helper D3's fins.py uses for the boss and root geometry

nodes.title: Wing skin heights along the fin root (S5010, c 0.32 m)
nodes.text: [x, z_upper, z_lower] in metres at the fin plane; the fin roots follow these, the bosses start from them
nodes.basis: k09kit.surface_z on subsystems/wing/s5010.dat (SRC-C4-S5010); 14 stations from x 0.0335 to the TE

nodes.title: Block bore ends (boss tops) +30.4 / -16.6 mm
nodes.text: z of the upper and lower ends of D3's 47.0 mm tube bore: highest upper skin (lowest lower skin) under the keyhole boss footprint plus the 8 mm boss height
nodes.basis: subsystems/fins/fusion/fins.py G['boss_u'], G['boss_l'] evaluated with params A1-R2 and fin_detail (C4 re-ran the same expressions)

nodes.title: Motor mount 11.3 g, CG 4.6 mm ahead, 9.7 mm below the motor axis
nodes.text: [mass kg, dx, dy (+ outboard), dz (+ away from the wing)] of FIN-003-UR from the motor station (0.045, 0.32, 0.19)
nodes.basis: subsystems/fins/interfaces.json FIN-003-UR mass_g 11.28, cg_xyz_m (0.0404, 0.3218, 0.1803) (D3 CAD centroid)

nodes.title: Station collar 5.7 g, brace 7.4 g
nodes.text: [collar kg, brace kg]; collar lumped on the tube at the collar, half the brace at the ear

nodes.title: Mount rocking stiffness 3 000 N m/rad
nodes.text: Rotational stiffness of the printed mount about x and y between the tube end and the motor base
nodes.basis: 12 mm slit collar on the tube as an elastic foundation: k = (E_PETG / t_wall) d l^3 / 12 = (2 GPa / 2 mm) x 0.022 x 0.012^3 / 12 = 3 200 N m/rad; the lip cap on the tube end adds to it; range 1 000-10 000. Static test T-C4-MOUNT-STIFF replaces it

nodes.title: Mount twist stiffness 30 000 N m/rad
nodes.text: Rotational stiffness of the clamped collar about the tube axis below the slip torque
nodes.basis: collar wall in shear: (G_PETG / t_wall) 2 pi r^3 l = (0.75 GPa / 2 mm) 2 pi 0.011^3 0.012 = 3.8e4 N m/rad

nodes.title: Root rotational stiffness 10 000 N m/rad
nodes.text: Tube fixity at the bore end (block + bosses + core), about x and y
nodes.basis: R1 foundation estimate 3 000 N m/rad for a 27 mm PETG bore x (47/27)^3 = 5.3 for the 47 mm bore with bosses, halved because the bosses are 2.4 mm C-rings: ~10 000; swept 3 000-rigid

nodes.title: Anchor + spar local stiffness 3e7 N/m along the brace
nodes.text: Series spring of the printed anchor (bond line, 8 mm saddle) and the local spar/core under it
nodes.basis: PETG saddle 20 x 16 mm, 8 mm: E A / t = 2 GPa x 3.2e-4 / 0.008 = 8e7 N/m; spar ring and core about the same; series ~3e7 (the 10 x 3 brace alone is EA/L 2.2e7 N/m)

nodes.title: Peel knock-down 0.5 on bond allowables for joints loaded in pull-off
nodes.text: Factor on ASM-C4-BOND-SHEAR for the anchor on the spar and the collar ear
nodes.basis: PETG bonds peel at a fraction of lap shear; C6 coupons replace it

nodes.title: General quad shell element checks
nodes.equation: (a) shell_q4 = shell_element on a 20 x 30 mm rectangle (max relative entry difference); (b) cantilever 0.2 x 0.2 m plate on a 16 x 16 mesh with interior nodes skewed by up to 20 % of an element, f1 vs Leissa lambda^2 = 3.492 (stiff core)

nodes.title: Station modes, D3 as designed (fin_detail.layers board), upper UR and lower LR, nominal E/G
nodes.equation: FE (fin_fe.build_q): tube frame + 1-layer board (mapped Q4 shell) + edge strips + brace (EA/L in series with the anchor) + mount springs + motor/prop/mount rigid body; station mode = >= 10 % of kinetic energy in the rigid body; sep = min |f/f_k - 1| over 1P/2P hover, 1P/2P cruise, 1P cap

nodes.title: Station modes, recommended: D3 geometry with fins.layers boards (params), brace and edge strips, nominal E/G
nodes.equation: as CALC-C4-D3-MODES with the board layers from params.json (fins.layers)

nodes.title: Separation over the tube E/G corners, recommended design
nodes.equation: min over side x E {lo, nom, hi} x G {lo, nom, hi} of sep_op (18 FE runs), mount and root at their nominal springs

nodes.title: Mount rocking stiffness needed for the separation rule, recommended design
nodes.equation: sweep k_rock over 500-30 000 N m/rad (k_twist fixed) on both quarters at nominal and low E/G; k_req = smallest k with sep_op >= sep_min at every larger k (log interpolation)

nodes.title: Mesh convergence, recommended design (both sides)
nodes.equation: first dominant station mode f1 (>= 50 % kinetic energy in the motor body) and sep_op at fin meshes 12x10, 24x20 (used), 36x30; change = max over sides of |f1(24x20)/f1(36x30) - 1| and |sep(24x20)/sep(36x30) - 1| (f2 reported only: near 360-600 Hz it swaps between coupled modes)

nodes.title: Gyroscopic whirl separation, recommended design (both sides)
nodes.equation: M q'' + Omega G q' + K q = 0 on 16 modes, G = -[Ip_spin e_shaft]x at the station; sep over 1P/2P at hover and cruise and 1P at the cap, station whirl modes only

nodes.title: Fin, tube, brace, collar and anchor strength, recommended design (both sides)
nodes.equation: FE static, cases L1, L4 (both friction senses), L5, G2 (both senses, n_h m g at the tube end), H2; ultimate = sf x limit (joints x fit x prt); face = Q_f (eps0 + z kappa); brace Pcr = pi^2 E w t^3 / (12 L^2); brace-end bond tau = F / (2 (w + t) engage); ear root s = 6 F (ear/2) / (w_ear h^2) + F / (w_ear h) (interlayer); collar bond tau = T / (2 pi r^2 h) + F / (pi d h); anchor tau = F / (len_y pi d_spar / 4) vs peel x bond allowable

nodes.title: Through-core block on D3's geometry (bosses not credited for strength)
nodes.equation: as CALC-C4-BLOCK with h = core depth at the tube (z_upper - z_lower at x_t): tube bore s = 6M/(d h^2) + F/(d h); shear-out tau = (1.5 M / h)/(e h), e = (W - d)/2; spar bore s = 6M/(d W^2) + F/(d W); web s = 6M/(W h^2), tau = M/(0.21 W h^2); bond torsion tau = 2 My sf fit prt/(pi d^2 W)

nodes.title: Fins mass, recommended design (second board layer on D3's CAD)
nodes.equation: half-fin area = integral over x_le..x_te of (z_top(x) - z_skin(x)), z_top linear from the collar top to hh; added = (lay_rec - lay_d3) (areal + adh) x (2 upper + 2 lower areas); total = CL-D3-MASS + added

nodes.title: Mount rocking stiffness on the bench
nodes.procedure: Mount with motor clamped on a 60 mm tube stub held in a vice; 0.5 kg over a pulley at the prop nut, sideways (y) and fore-aft (z); dial gauges at the motor can top and at the collar; theta = (d_can - d_collar) / spacing; k = F a / theta. Pass: k >= the CL-C4-D3-MOUNT-K-REQ value in both directions.

nodes.title: Tap test, as-built upper and lower quarter
nodes.procedure: Finished wing on foam blocks, props on; tap each motor bell in y and in z; FC raw IMU at 1 kHz (or a phone accelerometer taped to the can); FFT peaks vs 1P/2P at hover, cruise and the cap.
